spans.s:
घोणा f. (णा)
 1. The nose.
 2. The nose or nostrils of a horse.
 E. घुण् to
roll, to turn, and अच् and टाप् affs.

घोणिन् m. (-णी) A hog.
 E. घोणा nose or snout, and इनि aff.

घोण्टा f. (-ण्ठा)
 1. The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.)
 2. The betelnut tree:
see गुवाक.
 3. A timber tree, (Schrebera swietenioides.)
 E. घुट् to
resist, affix अच् and नुम् inserted or घुण वा ट ।
